due_when.clears_when: link-state-dump on tradeify_1 lists its watchlist rows (or the mode is retired for tradeify with a stated reason), or killed with a reason

origin.rerun: Dispatch breakout-login-check account tradeify_1 apply: link-state-dump; the bug stands while link_state_dump.rows is [] although the watchlist (instrument-info-dry watchlist_diff) lists symbols.

what: link-state-dump (LINK_STATE_DUMP_JS) reads watchlist rows only inside the Symbol/Bid/Ask HEADER table. tradeify_1 renders its watchlist header and rows as two SEPARATE tables (MEASURED #15602/#15648), so link-state-dump #15687 (run 37067249993) reported rows: [] and a header-only tr while the watchlist held ETHUSD, SOLUSD, XRPUSD (re-read by instrument-info-dry #15684-#15686). The dump therefore cannot show tradeify's row state. Read path only; WATCHLIST_SYMBOLS_JS already handles the split.
